quarterly_data.quarter: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Deutsche Bank Healthcare Summit 2026 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chief R&D Officer Rob: at the second interim analysis of HERIZON-GEA-01 'we now have a stat sig result for the zani-chemo versus the control arm', and the hazard ratios for both experimental arms 'continue to improve even from the first interim analysis'; the data will be published at an upcoming medical conference. He called the IHC 3+ restriction on the doublet label not a meaningful limitation - that subgroup was 'less than 20%' of trial patients - and said the triplet should be used irrespective of PD-L1 status. Jack (Jazz) said first-line HER2 ADC trials such as T-DXd 'don't read out until 2029' and that Jazz is 'the only regimen that's being actively promoted in the first line'.
quarterly_data.figure: doublet OS statistically significant at second interim analysis; IHC 2+ subgroup less than 20%; competing first-line readouts 2029

quarterly_data.quarter: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Deutsche Bank Healthcare Summit 2026 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chief R&D Officer Rob on expanding Ziihera: the pan-tumor basket trial is enrolling toward a potential tumor-agnostic indication; after breakthrough designation in second-line colorectal cancer, Jazz is 'in discussions with the FDA on the path to a rapid approval in colorectal cancer'; the frontline BTC pivotal trial is enrolling; and Jazz is 'deep into planning' an early-stage neoadjuvant/adjuvant gastric study. In breast cancer it plans earlier lines in combination with a novel HER2 TKI, via 'a collaboration with Boehringer Ingelheim on zongertinib' and a partnership 'with Iambic on their IAM1363', plus the I-SPY and MD Anderson collaborations and its own neoadjuvant phase II. These underpin the revised $3 billion-$5 billion potential.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Deutsche Bank Healthcare Summit 2026 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chief R&D Officer Rob on neuroscience: Jazz is initiating four new Epidiolex clinical trials - a phase II in focal onset seizures, a potentially pivotal phase II/III in juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, a phase III across a broad array of DEEs aimed at a broad DEE label (FDA showed 'an openness' to it), and an adult LGS evidence study - alongside the capsule formulation application. The Kv7 opener is planned to enter phase I, the next-generation orexin 2 agonist 'has cleared the IND and is expected to go into healthy volunteer studies this year', and Jazz closed the Actio deal the day before, with KCNT1 clinical data to be published soon. The Modeyso ACTION trial interim overall survival analysis is reiterated for next year, an early opportunity for frontline high-grade glioma approval.
quarterly_data.figure: four new Epidiolex clinical trials; orexin 2 agonist healthy volunteer studies this year; ACTION interim OS next year
